description: This file defines a BudgetService class that provides CRUD operations (list, create, update, remove) for budget data, interacting with an API client to communicate with a backend server.

classes.name: BudgetService
classes.description: A service class that manages CRUD operations for budgets via an API client.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of budgets, optionally filtered by month.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget identified by its ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a budget entry identified by its ID.
